title: The Strict rule of the school
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：strict　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strict 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the musician wrote of ① a strict rule of the school in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② stricter than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the strict ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the strictest rule of the school anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too strict to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the strict ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a strict teacher of the class, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as strict as the teacher of the class they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was strict or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something strict, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite strict; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the strict ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, with great care, she wrote of another strict rule of the school in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ stricter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The strictest teacher of the class in the whole hall, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the strict ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 严格（前置定语 a strict rule of the school：1959 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件严格的规矩）
B. adj. 严格／严厉（比较级 stricter than：文中两处，一处比学校严格的规矩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 严格／严厉（最高级 the strictest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 严格（表语 too strict to do：母亲觉得它太严格，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 严厉（前置定语 a strict teacher of the class：叔叔把整件事称作一桩严厉的班主任）
F. adj. 严厉（同级比较 as strict as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩严厉的班主任相比）
G. adj. 严厉（后置定语 something strict：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 严厉（受程度副词修饰 quite strict：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a strict rule of the school
the strictest rule of the school anybody
a strict teacher of the class
The strictest teacher of the class in

answers.why: strict 意为“严格”，1959 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件严格的规矩”，此处作前置定语 a strict rule of the school。
strict 意为“严格”，此处用比较级 stricter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
strict 意为“严格”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最严格的一件，故用最高级 the strictest rule of the school。
strict 意为“严格”，母亲认为这件东西“太严格了，谁也用不上”，too strict to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
strict 意为“严厉”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩严厉的班主任”，此处作前置定语 a strict teacher of the class。
strict 意为“严厉”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩严厉的班主任一样严厉”，同级比较用 as strict as。
strict 意为“严厉”，节目单上那半行字要的是“严厉的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something strict。
strict 意为“严厉”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当严厉”，quite 修饰原级 strict。
strict 意为“严厉”，1969 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要严厉”，故用比较级 stricter than。
strict 意为“严厉”，母亲 1971 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最严厉的那一桩”，故用最高级 the strictest teacher of the class。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件严格的规矩。（a strict rule of the school）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更严格。（stricter than …）
母亲觉得它太严格，谁也用不上。（too strict to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩严厉的班主任。（a strict teacher of the class）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩严厉的班主任一样严厉。（as strict as …）
到了 1966 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件严厉的东西。（something strict）
answers: In 1959 the musician wrote of a strict rule of the school in the programme.
Everybody said it was stricter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too strict to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a strict teacher of the class.
He said nobody would call it as strict as the teacher of the class they had once had.
By 1966 the programme asked for nothing but something strict.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 strict 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the musician wrote of a strict rule of the school in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the strictest rule of the school in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too strict to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a strict teacher of the class, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite strict, and everybody laughed.
The strict ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
